lines: A journal. Half burned, half soaked. The entries still legible are dated from three years ago.
Someone traveled this road in better days and wrote it all down.

choices.text: Burn the rest. Leave no record of the dead.

lines: The last entry: "The road gate was shut. The cultists were already inside. We ran north. There were children with us."
The entry ends mid-sentence.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: Old graveyard on the ridge. The markers are in two styles: the old round-topped ones, and newer markers — angular, with veil-sigils.
Someone has been using this place for new burials. The veil-marked ones don't match the names on any roster.

choices.text: [Perception - INT] Read the new markers carefully.
[Strength - STR] Dig up one of the new markers.

lines: Three of the names appear on Emberguard missing-person reports from last year.
The handwriting was deliberately blurred. Someone didn't want these read.
Nothing. The grave was never filled. It was marked for someone who's still alive — or someone who was expected to die.

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: The old hermit finds you here.
"I've lived in this wood for sixty years. Used to be beautiful. Used to be quiet."

choices.text: You haven't got time for nostalgia.

lines: "There was a night — maybe fifteen years back — when the whole wood glowed orange. Not fire. The trees themselves, glowing. It was the last beautiful thing before everything started."
"The Emberveil is old. Older than the kingdom. Older than us. We just woke it up."
"Or something woke it up for us."
You camp, and the Veilscar dreams through you.
Three images: a city of glass. A hand holding a crown of ash. A door closing — from the outside.

choices.text: Write it down before it fades.
Shake it off. Dreams are noise.

lines: The glass city is the pre-Sovereign architecture. The crown of ash is the Sovereign's sigil. The door closing: you've seen it before — in the Library Ruins inscription.
The images dissolve before you can hold them. Only the feeling remains: something is wrong with time here.

nodes.speaker: marek_greel_story
lines: "You want to know about the eye."
"Everyone does. It's the most visible thing about me, and the least important."
"I looked into the first rift. Before we knew what it was. Before we knew enough to look away."
"The eye sees the Veil now. Constantly. It is not a comfortable way to live."
He blinks — both eyes. "Most people can't help themselves." A pause. "Thirty years. Since the first rift opened."
"Thirty years. I was seventeen. The rift lasted eight seconds. My notes from those eight seconds still fill three shelves."

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The plains were farmland before the burning.
The bone-reader counts what's left of the livestock markers at every field boundary she passes.
"Because no one else does. And if no one counts, then no one remembers how much was lost."

nodes.speaker: veil_convert
lines: He doesn't try to hide the cult brand on his wrist.
"I wasn't born into it. I walked in on my own. That's the part that bothers people most."
"Because the Veil is the only honest thing left. Everything else pretends the world is fixable. The Veil doesn't pretend."
He talks for a long time. You don't agree with any of it. But you understand it better now. That's worse.

nodes.speaker: swamp_guide
lines: The fen was a battlefield. Before your time, before anyone's time.
The weapons are still here if you know where to look. So are the soldiers.

choices.text: [Survival - CON] Search the muck for old weapons.

lines: "Drowned. Still at their posts, far as the fen's concerned." She taps her head. "Come at the wrong hour and they'll try to finish the old war on you."

choices.text: "How do we know which hour is wrong?"

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: The Stoneward toll road was built by the third king.
He taxed it to fund the fourth king's war. The fourth king lost. The tax survived.

choices.text: Ask about the fourth king's war.
That explains the toll, at least.

lines: "He fought the Ancient Pact — tried to pave the sacred groves for roads." A pause. "The roads are ash. The groves are still there."

nodes.speaker: marek_greel_story
lines: The Library held the definitive account of the first Rift event.
It also held the names of everyone who signed the order to suppress that account.

choices.text: [Arcana - INT] Find surviving fragments with names.
Ask Marek who was on that list.

lines: Three names. One is a dead faction leader. One is the current Brightfall Council Chair. One is Marek.
Smoke-stained fragments. Deliberate. Whoever burned the library was thorough.

choices.text: The burning is its own evidence.

lines: "I was on it. I know. I signed it because I thought suppression was safer." He meets your eyes. "I was wrong. Obviously."

nodes.speaker: ancient_guardian_npc
lines: The stone here is old enough to have a name in a language that predates the kingdom.
It translates roughly to: 'the place where the deal was struck'.
"The settlers offered stewardship. The land offered shelter. Simple."
"The Ashen Veil is what happens when one side stops paying."

choices.text: Move on with that in mind.

nodes.speaker: rift_warden
lines: The crown predates the Sovereign.
He didn't forge it — he found it. And then he found what it does to the wearer.

choices.text: [Occult - INT] Study the crown's resonance from here.

lines: "It shows the wearer the Rift. Constantly. Waking and sleeping."
"After thirty years of that, you stop being entirely... you."
The Architect's Verge has no architect on record.
The structures here predate human tools — possibly human hands.
The joints are seamless. Not carved or fitted — grown. Something shaped the stone from inside.

nodes.speaker: rift_warden
lines: "The Rift wasn't an accident."
"It was opened from this side. By someone who wanted it open."
"The Council. The original Brightfall Council. They thought they could control what came through."
"They were wrong in ways that have taken thirty years to stop being surprising."

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: The innkeeper hums while he works.
It's a road song — the kind travelers learn so they have something to do with their mouths when the miles are empty.
"It's about a man who walked the same road home for forty years and never reached it."
"Different versions end differently. In the fen version, he gets there. In the ridge version, he doesn't."

nodes.speaker: marek_greel_story
lines: "The Veilscar is what the Rift leaves behind."
"Every hour the Rift is open, the scar grows. At current rate, it will reach Brightfall in eight years."

choices.text: [Arcana - INT] Run the math on the spread rate.
"Then we need to close the Rift."

lines: The math is worse than Marek's estimate. He used a conservative baseline.

choices.text: "We have less time than you think."

lines: Eight years. Against that deadline, everything else snaps into focus.

nodes.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines: Orren stops at a particular stone on the ridge.
He doesn't say anything. He just stands.
"My brother. Three years." A pause. "He's not in there. Just the armor."
"I keep coming back because I can't think of a better plan."
"Someone I knew." He turns away from the stone. "Come on."

nodes.speaker: swamp_guide
lines: The Plague Fen wasn't always plague.
It was farmland. The sickness came with the first Rift pulse — three days of rain that wasn't rain.
"It fell upward. At the edges. Toward the Rift."
"Everything it touched grew. Then grew wrong."
It's a veil-spore colony, not a traditional pathogen. It's alive. It's communicating — not with you, but with the Rift.
This stretch of the road is cracked and overgrown.
Once, travelers shared tales by the fire here. Now, only silence remains.

choices.text: Search for remnants of those stories.

lines: A weathered stone tablet lies half-buried in moss.
The inscriptions speak of hope and shared journeys.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: You can feel it, can't you? The weight of what was.
The road remembers, even if we wish it wouldn't.
This was once a bustling trade route, now forgotten.
The last caravan passed through five years ago.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: Lyra kneels beside a faded signpost, tracing the letters with her fingers.
"These names... they were once vital to our lives."
You recognize one name from a vanished merchant guild.
Their goods were once the pride of Brightfall.
The letters are too weathered to make sense of.
Lyra sighs, a quiet disappointment in her eyes.
A scattered collection of broken carts lies abandoned.
Their wood is splintered, stories trapped within.
A child's doll, worn and forgotten, catches your eye.
It tells tales of innocence lost, a reminder of what was.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: Dusty tomes line the shelves, pages fluttering as if alive.
One book bears the sigil of the Ashen Veil, its content dark and twisting.
A passage reveals part of the Veil's true purpose, unsettling yet enlightening.

choices.text: Make a mental note of it.

lines: A gust of wind slams the book shut, as if warning you away.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The shrinekeeper examines an old scroll, expression grave.
"It speaks of the Sovereign's influence over forgotten minds."

nodes.speaker: null
lines: A cracked mural depicts the Ember Rift and figures shrouded in shadow.
Each figure's face bears a different expression, sorrowful or ecstatic.
You recognize one face — a member of the Emberguard missing for years.
The details blur together, nothing reveals itself to you.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: Yasha touches a stone tablet, eyes clouded with memory.
"This once held the council's true history, now lost to the Veil."

nodes.speaker: null
lines: Scattered pages litter the floor, marked with erratic scribbles.
One page refers to a 'hidden path' towards the Rift.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: The air hums with despair. Something beyond the gate waits for you.
An echo of past choices resonates here, drawing the unwary closer.

nodes.speaker: null
lines: A shattered relic lies half-buried. Its surface is etched with desperate prayers.
What once held power now feels like a warning.

choices.text: Leave it be, no point tempting fate.

lines: You find remnants of a long-forgotten truth, a past entwined with the current darkness.
Better left undisturbed. The weight of the past lingers in the air.

nodes.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines: Bram pauses, eyes narrowed at the horizon. A chill hangs in the air.
"This place... it feels wrong. What draws us here may consume us."

choices.text: Continue forward regardless of the warning.
Take a moment to gather your thoughts.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: The old road stretches ahead, cracked and overgrown. Once, it was a path of hope.
Now, it leads only to memories lost to shadows.

choices.text: Look back at the fading light.
Press on, no time for nostalgia.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: The shelves here still whisper, if you listen closely.
They remember knowledge lost to time, fragments of what once was.

choices.text: [Intellect - INT] Search the shelves for anything useful.
Leave the whispers behind and move on.

lines: You unearth a scroll, its parchment brittle and delicate.
The ink spells out practices long forgotten, tied to the Veil.
Just dust and decay. The knowledge here is better lost than found.
Some secrets were never meant to resurface.
This path is worn by forgotten travelers. The dust has settled thick.
Once, laughter mingled with the wind; now, only silence remains.

choices.text: Move on; there's nothing for you here.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: Tattered pages scattered across the floor. Each one speaks of the Rift's true origin.
The ink tells stories of a betrayal no one wanted to believe.
A broken cart lies by the roadside, wheels sunk in mud.
A faded merchant's sign creaks overhead, swinging in the breeze.

choices.text: Leave the cart alone and continue walking.

lines: A torn ledger. The last entry notes a delivery to Brightfall.
The ink is smeared, perhaps from rain — or tears.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: The scout sits by a flickering fire, eyes distant.
"Used to be travelers would sing along this path. Not anymore."

choices.text: Ask what happened to the travelers.
Sit by the fire and share stories.

lines: A dilapidated shrine stands overgrown with weeds.
Old stones bear faint carvings, almost illegible.

choices.text: [Dexterity - DEX] Clear away the weeds to see better.
Leave the shrine untouched. It's not your place.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: Shelves of knowledge, now dust and ash. Forgotten tomes whisper tales of the Rift.
This place held answers once. Now, it only echoes silence.

choices.text: [Intellect - INT] Search the remaining shelves for any texts.
Leave the ruins. There's nothing here for you now.

lines: You find a single unburned tome. Its pages detail the cult's rituals, the Long Look.
Knowledge lost, now reclaimed. This could change everything.
Only dust remains in your hands. The answers still elude you.

choices.text: Move on. This place is a dead end.

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: They say the scholars here once knew the way to the Rift. They don't anymore.
Fragments of their knowledge are scattered, like the stones of this building.

choices.text: Dismiss the talk and focus on your mission.

lines: A tattered cloak lies in the mud. The fabric is heavy with the weight of sorrow.
Someone abandoned it here, hoping to leave their past behind.

choices.text: Leave it be. Not your burden.

lines: A single note remains, stained and torn: "The road is no longer safe. Meet at the old tree."
Hope has fled this route.

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: Dusty shelves hold books untouched for years.
Pages speak of the Rift's first whispers, long before it opened.
The account details a ritual conducted long ago, a summoning gone wrong.
It suggests the Rift was never meant to close.

choices.text: File this information away for later.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: This place was once vibrant, full of seekers and scholars.
Now it echoes with forgotten truths and lost knowledge.

choices.text: Walk away, feeling the weight of neglect.

lines: A mural on the wall depicts the Rite of Awakening, elaborate and chaotic.
Something about it stirs a memory of the Ashen Veil.

choices.text: Trace the symbol with your finger.
Step back and ignore it for now.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: These ruins are a library of lost hope, a sanctuary for secrets.
You seek knowledge, yet knowledge demands a price.

choices.text: Ask about the price for wisdom.
Turn away, feeling the chill of the air.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: Among these remains, the echoes of scholars linger.
They feared what they uncovered, and they should have.

choices.text: Remember their caution, it may serve you well.
Dismiss their warnings; your path is set.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: A chill runs through the stones. This place is both gateway and grave, in equal measure.

choices.text: Dismiss the stones as mere rock.

lines: A weathered stone sits at the road's edge, half-buried in soil.
It bears the names of travelers long lost to memory.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: Shelves once laden with wisdom now stand bare.
Dust dances in the remnants of lost knowledge. They sought to remember, yet forgot too much.

choices.text: Search the remnants for something useful.
Turn away from the ruins. There's nothing left here.

lines: A hidden compartment reveals a tarnished emblem of the Pact.
Its inscription speaks of a promise unkept, a warning unheeded.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: You did well to find this place. The past bleeds into our present, does it not?
Each shadow here tells a story — if only they were less mute.

choices.text: What stories linger in these shadows?

lines: A broken cart lies abandoned by the roadside.
The wheels are sunk in mud, and the canvas flaps listlessly in the wind.

choices.text: Search the cart for anything useful.
Leave it. There's nothing to gain here.

lines: Old rations, moldy and inedible. A small dagger, its hilt chipped but blade intact.
Someone tried to flee, but it ended poorly.

choices.text: Take the dagger and move on.
Leave the dagger. Its past troubles you.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: The scout stands by a makeshift post.
"This road used to connect villages. Now it only leads to shadows."

choices.text: Move along. There's no comfort here.

lines: "They were swallowed by the Veil. All of them. No survivors."
His voice drops, like a tomb's silence.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: Lyra points to a faded signpost, half-buried in leaves.
"It used to say where to find the Ember Shrines. Now, it's just a whisper of what was."

choices.text: Ignore it. The past doesn't help now.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: The air thickens with dread here. Shadows pool near the Riftgate, waiting.

choices.text: Listen closely for whispers in the dark.
Move on. There's nothing to gain here.

lines: Voices murmur in the void, speaking of lost paths and ancient debts.

choices.text: Leave with the weight of the words.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The shrine here is cracked, drawing in dark energy like a moth to flame.
A price was paid for silence, but the cost is rising.

choices.text: [Intellect - WIS] Inspect the shrine for hidden inscriptions.
Turn away. No good can come from this place.

lines: An inscription speaks of a pact with forces beyond comprehension.
The words hint at old treaties broken, leading to the Rift's birth.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Captain Maer stands watch, eyes reflecting both resolve and weariness.
"We march toward our doom, or our salvation. Either way, the cost will be steep."

choices.text: Ask about the cost Maer speaks of.
Simply nod in agreement. Move on.

lines: "Every step forward is paid with blood. The question is whose?"

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The bone reader kneels, sifting through remnants of lives lost.
"Each fragment tells a story, but the truth is a curse."

choices.text: [Strength - STR] Dig deeper to uncover hidden truths.
Step back. Some truths are better left buried.

lines: You learn of a lost heir, bound to the Rift by blood and betrayal.

nodes.speaker: null
lines: A shattered stone lays beneath the shadow of the Riftgate.
Cracks form intricate patterns, like veins of the land marred by agony.

choices.text: Examine the stone closely for latent energies.
Leave it alone. No stone is worth the risk here.

lines: A pulse thrums beneath your fingers, a call to those who listen.
The stone vibrates with memories of ancient horrors.
A weathered signpost leans against a gnarled tree, barely legible now.
Once it pointed towards home, now it just points to lost paths.

choices.text: Leave it be, no need to linger.
Mark your way on the tree nearby.
Move on without a backward glance.

lines: The inscription reads: 'To Emberwood, three days hence.'
The final word is scratched out, almost like it was forgotten.

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: The innkeeper recalls stories of travelers lost here,
"Once a bustling road, now a whisper of what was."

choices.text: Leave, unsure of what to make of it.

lines: "People used to travel with hope. Now they flee with fear."
He pauses, eyes distant as if seeing the past.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: A scout surveys the area. "Roads change, you know. This one was once safe."
Now, it's just another path where shadows linger.

choices.text: Move on, the past is past.

lines: "Cultists roam these woods. Travelers seldom return."
His eyes narrow, scanning the treeline.

choices.text: Doubt his tale, press forward regardless.

lines: A shallow grave lies half-covered by foliage, remnants of a past struggle.
The earth is disturbed, something was buried in haste.

choices.text: Mark the spot, take note for later.

lines: A rusted dagger peeks from the dirt, slick with dampness.
Next to it, a torn piece of cloth, stained dark.

choices.text: Take the dagger, a useful find.

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: The hermit whispers as he passes, "The road remembers those who traveled it."
Be wary, for memory is a heavy burden.

choices.text: Listen to his words, wisdom shared.

lines: A weathered tome rests on the altar, pages yellowed and brittle.
The title reads: 'The Origins of the Rift' in faded script.
The first entry details a ritual conducted fifteen years ago, invoking the Rift.
It speaks of a promise made, a bargain struck in darkness.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: Lyra examines the shelves, dust swirling in the air.
"These texts hold more than just words; they whisper truths long buried."
